auto_chess.kind: frames cut from PMD sheets and packed per Pokémon (anim names Attack, Hop, Hurt, Idle, Shoot, Sleep, Walk, 8 directions)
auto_chess.why_pending: Code is GPL-3; the repository states no licence or artist for these atlases (pokemons/credits.json has no entry for them). Frame timings are not stored.

darkusshadow.kind: ALTERNATIVE_STYLE: Paldea overworld sprite sheets, not PMD; download needs a DeviantArt login
darkusshadow.note: Named in the pages' credits text. Maschiff and every DLC species are not named. The artist says 'free for everyone to use in their Pokémon projects, please give credits'. The sheet files were not inspected.
